_metadata.description: Container styles and product lines: the deterministic frame a mark is composed into, shared across a product line.

requirements.title: Container style records
requirements.description: A ContainerStyle holds shape, corner_ratio, background (kind and stops), mark_scale, maskable_scale, accent_glow (colour plus layers of width and opacity) and small_mark_threshold_px, with create/read/update/list.

validation.notes: Domain implemented and live-verified (brand aquila explore/import/pick, styles seed); unit tests with a fake image-tools client are still to be written.

requirements.title: constellation-midnight seeded from the approved Aquila tile
requirements.description: The star line shares the container style constellation-midnight, seeded once with the measured mark_scale from the approved mark and the documented gradient, corner ratio and glow values.

validation.notes: Domain implemented and live-verified (brand aquila explore/import/pick, styles seed); unit tests with a fake image-tools client are still to be written.

requirements.title: Product lines
requirements.description: A ProductLine holds id, name, container_style_id and ordered product names, seeded with the Star line (Aquila, Vega, Rigel, Mizar, Pan, Messier) linked to constellation-midnight.

validation.notes: Domain implemented and live-verified (brand aquila explore/import/pick, styles seed); unit tests with a fake image-tools client are still to be written.
